reviews.author: L. Gilbert
reviews.text: Ernie, Mike, and Taw provided excellent service. From the estimate to a short-circuit repair and the installation of crawl space receptacles, they were courteous, fair, and supremely efficient. Highly recommend this team of true professionals.

reviews.author: Jerseypiney Girl
reviews.text: We hired Josh and his team to install electric service for our trailer and septic. They did a great job. They were professional and took care of all necessary permits for our job. We highly recommend Josh and EL Electric and would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Connor Kasten
reviews.text: EL Electric is really the best. They are knowledgeable, professional, fair, courteous, and responsive. I have had them over for multiple jobs from a complete kitchen remodel to a simple switch installation. I cannot recommend them enough and they will be my electrician of choice moving forward.

reviews.author: Matt Blockholm
reviews.text: Best Electrical Services in New Bern Area! Ernie is a true professional, encompasses integrity and knowledge. Just had an Electrical Emergency. Josh, Mike and Jacob arrived quickly, made all repairs and restored power within 1 hour. Josh and Melvin installed my new 200Amp service for my workshop/garage and ran a 100' + feeder with 50Amp connection for my RV trailer. Expectational workmanship and dedication! If your are looking for the job to be done correctly, these are the guys to call. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ralph Wood
reviews.text: Great communication. I had three separate projects completed. Fair priced. Professionally done by their team of skilled electricians. Great teamwork hashing out one of the complicated projects. This is a well run business. I will definitely use E.L. for future projects.

reviews.author: Cnonymous Jones
reviews.text: Ernie was a pleasure to speak with and was very understanding of the situation. We needed an electrician fast and he fit us in his schedule the same day! He was professional, made sure our questions were answered, let us know what he was able to do or not do for our needs (which means he was honest) and was reasonably priced for the service needed. We already plan to use him again in the future! I would 1000% recommend EL Electric for any of your needs! You won’t be let down!

reviews.author: Cathy Valerien
reviews.text: If you haven't used these guys yet, what are you waiting for! The guys are top notch! Ernie has a great crew and they are fast and efficient! One of his workers stayed behind today because I had a tenant that was a little upset. He would not leave until he knew I was good! Thank you Josh that was appreciated more than you know!! Seriously use the guys for any electrical project you have! You will NOT be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Patti Peebles
reviews.text: Ernie arrived as scheduled, provided written and fair estimate for my in home electric car charger. Installed as scheduled. Then, I had a problem, a bad charger. He returned quickly and worked in concert with my dealer and resolved the issue. Ernie is professional, reliable and knowledgeable and I applaud him and his company. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Stephen Beck
reviews.text: I would give 10 stars if I could. This holiday weekend my heat had cut off and when I looked outside the relay had burned up. I contacted Ernie and he got back to me within the hour and had my heat going in about 3 hours at a good price on top of it. Completely prompt, courteous, and professional. I'll be using this company again in an instant. Don't hesitate to call, I never leave reviews, but he earned it. Best serviceman ever.

reviews.author: Emma Wehrman
reviews.text: Ernie and his guys installed a new panel in a home addition for us, and wired the new panel to the main one. They were prompt, professional, reasonably priced, and did a great job. EL Electric is definitely our go to for any electrical work we need!

reviews.author: Karen Payton
reviews.text: Wow! That is just about all I can say. They arrived when they said they would. Got right to work. Everything is much better than they found it in an hour and a half. Mostly I loved the positive attitude. It might have been the worse rig job they have ever seen but they were there to fix it and did. Also, they worked me into the schedule. Price was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Kenneth Roosa
reviews.text: EL Electric installed my home generator a couple of years ago. I had a problem with it not transferring during a power outage. Ernie and crew came by and found a wire had come dislodged. These guys stand by their work! Cudos!

reviews.author: Eugene Gibson
reviews.text: Ernie and the team were great! They went above and beyond what my expectations were. I've never had a contractor that I was completely pleased with except these guys. They know what they're doing and left both work area better than it was when they got there!

reviews.author: Rebecca Floyd
reviews.text: Very friendly and considerate people. Gave us a fair quote and got the job done quickly. We will absolutely use them again in the future!

reviews.author: Kelsey Zito
reviews.text: There are NO words to describe the phenomenal work and dedication of this entire team! Thank you 1000x over for everything

reviews.author: Angela English
reviews.text: We have used E.L. Electric 3 or 4 times. Why? Well....it's not often that you find a company that is friendly, professional, knowledgeable, dependable and reasonably priced. We highly recommend them to anyone needing electrical services!

reviews.author: Christine Zelazo
reviews.text: Ernie was professional and delivered exactly what he promised. Went above and beyond expectations and treated our property with respect. Would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Juliet D
reviews.text: Excellent company! They came out the next day at exactly the time they said they'd arrive. They were professional and fast. Highly recommend! Great pricing too!

reviews.author: Jason Tomchesson
reviews.text: Ernie and I have been doing business for years and he is always goes above and beyond. If you want someone you can trust, shows up on time and completes the JOB then this is your company.

reviews.author: Alejandro Merizalde
reviews.text: Very professional and extremely well done job, responsive and quick turn around job. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Ryan Shute
reviews.text: I called these guys after 3 oclock on a friday afternoon and they had arrived, fixed what needed to be fixed and were gone within the hour. Super quick and efficient. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Phoneix Yt
reviews.text: Ernie L. Goes above and beyond. Nice to have a reliable electrician that does professional grade work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lindsay Thayer
reviews.text: We’ve used EL Electric for two house projects now and will continue to use them in the future. Very professional and able to work with the quirks and challenges of our old house!
